hero.title: Gramin: Savor Authentic Vegetarian Delights
hero.subtitle: Discover a world of plant-based culinary excellence at Gramin, crafted with passion, fresh ingredients, and time-honored recipes.

about.title: Welcome to Gramin: Our Pure Veg Philosophy
about.paragraph1: At Gramin, we believe in the vibrant power and purity of vegetarian cuisine. Our journey began with a simple yet profound vision: to offer a sanctuary where wholesome, plant-based dishes are celebrated through traditional Indian recipes and the freshest, locally sourced produce. Every meal at Gramin is prepared with care, ensuring an authentic taste that nourishes both body and soul.
about.paragraph2: We are more than just a restaurant; Gramin is a culinary experience dedicated to sustainability, health, and community. Our commitment extends beyond the plate, fostering an environment where every guest feels at home, enjoying flavors that evoke comfort and joy. Come, gather with us, and rediscover the simple pleasure of truly good, pure vegetarian food.
